Generalized Additive Model for Tumor Growth Data

Source: R/gam.R
tumr_gam.Rd

Generalized Additive Model for Tumor Growth Data

Usage

tumr_gam(tumr_obj = NULL, n_grid = 20, ...)

Arguments

tumr_obj

A tumr object created by tumr.

n_grid

Number of time grid points for prediction. Default 20.

...

Further arguments passed to gam.

Value

An object of class "tumr_gam" with components:

fit

The mgcv::gam object.

data

Processed data with internal column names.

formula

The formula used.

relevant_info

Named list of column names and reference group.

n_grid

Number of prediction grid points.

Examples

data(melanoma1)
melanoma1$months <- melanoma1$Day / (365/12)
mel1 <- tumr(melanoma1, ID, months, Volume, Treatment)
tumr_gam(mel1)
#> $fit
#> 
#> Family: gaussian 
#> Link function: identity

#> log(Volume) ~ Treatment + s(Time, by = Treatment) + s(ID, bs = "re") + 
#>     s(ID, Time, bs = "re")
